verdict: REJECT for deployment; no broad dialogue-quality improvement established
review: Agent inspection of exact generated transcripts; not native-human review or a calibrated accuracy score
limitations: Fixed comparison cases inspected during tuning; not blinded.
MLX backend raw inference, not Ollama app/voice path.
Two converted-base turns exceeded15 seconds despite14-second signal alarm; native execution delays Python signal delivery.
Safety and sentence heuristics do not measure fluency.
Few-shot family examples overlap validation topic; lower validation loss is insufficient.
